name: galaxz-more-voices
description: More notes at once on lead (3 -> 4) and chord (4 -> 6), in the pattern's layer and in the live one: 22 voices each instead of 19. They are records the OS already makes and the tables leave unused; 6 is the OS's own number for chord with generous_chords. The OS's overload line stays 265,000 cycles.

edits.evidence: [code] eight words, a track each, read only by getVoiceEndIndex (0x8012d1c4); first records at 0x815c7b0c: 0 2 4 6 8 10 14 16, 22 a layer; lead's are 10-13, 13 was never used
[code] eight words, a track each, read only by getVoiceEndIndex (0x8012d1c4); first records at 0x815c7b0c: 0 2 4 6 8 10 14 16, 22 a layer; chord's are 16-21
[code] the second table, taken when 0x8110e52c (generous_chords) is set; chord is 6 there already

risk: More voices are more CPU: about 10,000 cycles a block for each piano voice. Above the line the OS cuts the quietest note that is fading; notes held by key or pedal are not cut, so a very full hand can take the audio longer than the line. The load meter shows it.
